newsitem.title: USA: Dade County, Fla., housing agency chooses advisers.
newsitem.headline: Dade County, Fla., housing agency chooses advisers.

text.p: Florida's Dade County Housing Finance Authority has chosen Marianne Edmonds Inc and The Flood Co Inc as its financial advisers, an authority official said Friday.
The Flood Co., owned by Larry Flood, is headquartered in Montclair, N.J.
Marianne Edmonds recently left William R. Hough & Co to start her own financial advisory service in St. Petersburg, Fla.

The two were among nine firms that answered the authority's request for proposals. The contract, which still must be approved by the Dade County Commission, is for one year with two one-year renewal options.
The authority's executive director, Chris McFarlane, sought commission approval for three multi-family housing bond issues totalling $39.4 million.
He also sought approval to issue $150 million of single-family housing bonds over the next three years. Proceeds would fund low-interest loans for first-time buyers in Dade County.
The requests went before the commission's finance committee on Friday, and were forwarded to the full commission without recommendation becauset he committee lacked a quorum.
McFarlane said the underwriters for the multi-family bonds had not been chosen yet but would be selected by the apartment developers.
